It time-boxes the appointment and holds to the box; it keeps the sequence evidence-first, so listening, premise survey, screening and explanation of results all happen before any equipment is discussed; it requires that every decision-maker be present or that the decision be deferred without penalty; it prohibits manufactured urgency in all its forms, including expiring discounts, manager phone calls, and price differences that depend on signing tonight; it leaves the written packet and the test results behind whatever the outcome; and it defines a follow-up cadence with a stated stopping point once the answer is no, so a declined household is not pursued into resentment.

included: opening disclosure and consent to enter, sample and photograph
the evidence-first sequence and time-box
the prohibition on manufactured urgency
leave-behind and follow-up cadence with a stop point
excluded: the technical content of testing and interpretation
installation-day conduct and site protection

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: complaints alleging pressure, or visit records showing the evidence-first sequence being inverted

pros.claim: Disclosure-first framing lowers defensiveness and makes the evidence portion of the visit land
pros.example: a household that stops bracing for a pitch once told plainly in the first minute that the company sells equipment and the testing comes first

pros.claim: A stated follow-up stop point protects the brand in a small territory where reputation travels
pros.example: ending pursuit after the agreed contacts and later receiving a referral from that same household

cons.claim: Removing urgency lengthens the sales cycle and hands some decisions to whoever comes second with a deadline
cons.example: a customer taking a week to decide and meanwhile signing with a rival who offered an expiring price

cons.claim: A strict time-box can truncate a legitimately complex diagnosis in a multi-problem household
cons.example: a well property with several parameters where the honest survey and screening simply do not fit the standard appointment

failure_modes: discussing equipment before the results have been explained
letting an incentive quietly expire with the visit, which reintroduces the pressure the protocol removes
sampling or photographing without explicit permission
acceptance_tests: every visit record shows the opening disclosure, the consent obtained, and the evidence-first order actually followed
no quote in the file carries a price that changes if the customer does not sign during the visit
the leave-behind including test results was provided regardless of outcome
revisit_triggers: a complaint or review alleges pressure, surprise or unexplained testing
visit records show the sequence being inverted so equipment is discussed before results

nodes.definition: Handle, without either mudslinging or capitulation, the two forces that distort this market: competitors who sell on fear and internet claims that arrive at the house before the technician does. The routine answers with mechanism rather than accusation - explaining what an electrolysis precipitator physically does and why it behaves the same way in bottled mineral water, why a dissolved-solids number is an estimate of mineral content rather than a purity score, what the evidence status of ionised or 'structured' water claims actually is, and why a discount-retailer softener at a headline price may differ in resin volume, control valve, certified claims, warranty and who answers the phone when it fails. A household worried by a news cycle - a per- and polyfluoroalkyl substance story, a lead story, a boil-water notice - is answered with the specific test that would settle the question for their address rather than with a matching scare. Price competition is met on scope and evidence: what is included, what is certified for which claim, who installs it, and what happens on the day it stops working.

included: mechanism-based rebuttal of common demonstrations and claims
news-cycle worry answered with a testing offer
like-for-like comparison on certification, scope and service
excluded: disparaging named competitors or asserting their intent
any counter-claim that itself exceeds the evidence

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new viral water claim, a new competitor demonstration in the territory, or a recurring objection with no mechanism answer in the kit

pros.claim: Explaining the mechanism behind a rival demonstration disarms it permanently, because the customer can then see it for themselves
pros.example: showing that the precipitator produces the same coloured flocculant from bottled mineral water as from the customer's tap

pros.claim: Meeting a news-driven fear with a specific test converts anxiety into evidence and a defensible sale or a defensible no-sale
pros.example: responding to a regional contamination story by offering the laboratory panel for that parameter at this address

cons.claim: Correcting misinformation costs visit time and can position the representative as the argumentative one
cons.example: spending a large part of an appointment unpicking a video the customer trusts more than the technician

cons.claim: The company still loses jobs to fear-selling in the short run, and the discipline only pays back over a reputation cycle
cons.example: a neighbour buying an over-specified system from a scare pitch while the honest quote sits unsigned

failure_modes: answering a scare pitch with a bigger scare
disparaging a competitor personally rather than explaining the mechanism
conceding a claim to close, then owning it when the customer repeats it back later
acceptance_tests: each common competitor claim and viral claim has a written mechanism-based response in the sales kit with its supporting reference
no rebuttal in the kit asserts a health effect or a claim broader than the evidence behind it
news-driven enquiries are logged with the testing offer that was made
revisit_triggers: a new demonstration, product claim or viral water story appears in the territory
representatives report a recurring objection the kit has no mechanism answer for

nodes.definition: Close the sales process with one packaged dossier and an unambiguous gate, so that nothing is rediscovered by the installer or reinvented by the service scheduler. The dossier carries the confirmed water chemistry with sample dates, points, methods and laboratory reports; the problem classes accepted and those explicitly ruled out with the reason; the treatment classes chosen, each with its certification listing and the parameter it addresses; the premise facts and dated photographs, including plumbing material and era, heater age, static pressure, main shut-off location and existing equipment; the household constraints, including homeowner-association, rental, access and freezing risks; the signed quote with its disclosures and cancellation notice; the consumables the chosen classes will require, handed to the service-plan knowledge base as an input rather than as a designed plan; and the open questions, each with a named owner and a date. The gate is stated plainly and enforced: no installation date is promised and no service plan is enrolled until the dossier is complete and every claimed problem has its evidence attached.

included: the dossier contents and their evidence attachments
accepted and ruled-out problem classes with reasons
constraints and open questions with owners and dates
the no-install-date, no-enrolment gate
excluded: installation planning and scheduling itself
service-plan design, pricing and enrolment mechanics

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: installer or service-team reports of missing dossier information, or a dispute tracing to an unrecorded but known fact

pros.claim: A complete dossier removes the rediscovery cost that otherwise falls on the installer and the first service visit
pros.example: an installer arriving already knowing the plumbing material, shut-off location and that a homeowner-association rule constrains outdoor equipment

pros.claim: The gate stops a sale from outrunning its evidence, which is where most retractions and refunds begin
pros.example: holding an installation date until an outstanding laboratory result confirms the parameter the drinking-water stage was proposed for

cons.claim: The gate delays revenue at the exact moment a customer is most enthusiastic
cons.example: a signed job waiting several days for a result while the customer asks daily when installation will happen

cons.claim: Dossier discipline decays into box-ticking once volume rises, leaving the form complete and the evidence thin
cons.example: a photograph field filled with a generic shot of the garage that shows none of the constraints it was meant to capture

failure_modes: promising an installation date before outstanding evidence has returned
handing over a dossier whose ruled-out classes carry no reason
leaving open questions with no owner, so they arrive as surprises on installation day
acceptance_tests: no installation date exists in the schedule without a complete dossier attached to that job
every chosen treatment class in the dossier cites its target parameter, its evidence and its certification listing
each open question in the dossier has a named owner and a due date
revisit_triggers: an installer or service scheduler reports information missing from a dossier
a post-install dispute traces back to a fact that was known at the visit but never recorded

edges.why_related: the problem classes worth pursuing in a territory are the ones its water supplies and geology actually produce
intake questions exist to place a caller into a problem class and a supply type before a visit is booked
the safeguards for vulnerable households are the procedural half of the claim discipline that forbids fear-selling
the territory map identifies which community water system serves an address and therefore which annual report to pull
intake determines that the address is on a private well, which routes the whole diagnosis down the well path
the reported symptoms and supply type decide which screening instruments are run and which sample points matter
intake flags existing equipment, plumbing age and access constraints that the on-site survey then verifies
a demonstration is only permitted as an explanation of a measurement the panel actually produced
screening readings on health-based parameters are the trigger that sends a sample to the accredited laboratory
what the utility already reports and what it cannot cover determine which parameters still need laboratory work at this tap
well households have no supplier testing, so bacteriological and nitrate analysis at an accredited laboratory is the primary evidence
interpretation operates on a laboratory report with known methods and reporting limits, not on a field reading
knowing the mechanism a class claims is what makes it possible to check whether a specific model is listed for that claim
the mapping is only as sound as the mechanism reference it selects from, including each class's preconditions
a parameter can only be mapped to a treatment class once it is confirmed and compared to the applicable standard class
plumbing material, heater condition and existing equipment change which class is appropriate and in what order
where to treat is decided per confirmed problem after the class that treats it has been chosen
tiers are built from the scoped stages, so the treat-where decision fixes what the tiers can contain
a tier may only advertise the claims the certification listings of its specific models actually carry
each tier's equipment, labour and consumable content is what the cost build-up is computed over
the itemised lines in the packet come from the documented cost build-up rather than from a rate card
the packet restates each result against its standard class in the same non-medical language the interpretation established
the visit sequence includes only demonstrations the demo protocol permits, run in the order the protocol fixes
the visit choreography carries the vulnerability safeguards, from second-person attendance to the held price
a like-for-like comparison against a rival product is only possible from the certified claims each model actually holds
the signed packet with its disclosures is a required component of the dossier handed to installation and service
the consent record, visit log and leave-behind produced by the protocol are part of what the dossier must carry
the claim perimeter forces every field reading to be described as a screening indication and forbids reading safety into a dissolved-solids number
no sentence may enter the written packet that the claim perimeter would forbid in the living room
pricing and financing tactics that depend on urgency or complexity are unavailable where the vulnerability safeguards apply
a contaminant may only be mapped to a product whose listing covers that specific reduction claim
job margin grows with system size while the evidence often supports the smaller point-of-use scope
edges.resolution_rule: the confirmed evidence sets the scope; any additional stage that no dated result supports may appear only as a clearly optional line the customer can decline without changing what the recommendation solves

edges.why_related: presenting priced tiers during the visit competes with waiting days for the laboratory result that would justify them
edges.resolution_rule: aesthetic problems with a sound screening basis may be quoted the same day with the finding labelled as screening, while any health-based or microbiological parameter waits for the accredited result before it appears in a tier or a price

edges.why_related: the banned theatrical demonstrations are more persuasive in the moment than the honest chemistry the protocol permits
edges.resolution_rule: the demonstration ban holds without exception; the competitive response is to explain the mechanism of the rival demonstration and to offer the test that settles the question, never to match it

edges.why_related: plumbing material and era observed in the survey are what trigger a first-draw lead sampling protocol rather than a flushed one
reading the district's disinfectant and hardness before the visit decides which reagents are used and prevents mistaking chloramine for free chlorine
what installations and service visits actually find refines which problem classes the territory really presents
each new viral claim or rival pitch tests the claim perimeter and forces it to be restated in language the field can use
both are the pre-screening evidence path for their supply type, one supplied by the utility and one that the household must generate for itself

conflict_axes.name: same_visit_close_versus_laboratory_confirmation
conflict_axes.description: The visit is the cheapest moment to sell and the worst moment to have evidence, because an accredited result takes days while the household's attention lasts an evening.
poles: quote and close on screening evidence during the visit
hold the recommendation until the accredited laboratory result returns
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: split by parameter class: aesthetic problems with a sound screening basis may be quoted the same day with the finding labelled as screening, while every health-based or microbiological parameter waits for the laboratory report

conflict_axes.name: persuasive_theatre_versus_honest_chemistry
conflict_axes.description: Demonstrations that imply contamination close jobs that honest chemistry does not, which is exactly why they are the trade's most durable temptation.
poles: run only demonstrations the customer could repeat and would still endorse
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the demonstration ban absolutely, explain the mechanism of the rival demonstration instead, and compete on the offer of a real test

conflict_axes.name: minimal_sufficient_treatment_versus_margin_pull
conflict_axes.description: Every additional stage improves job margin and equipment revenue, while the evidence frequently justifies a smaller system than the company would like to sell.
poles: specify what the evidence supports and no more
specify the fuller system the household could afford
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the dated evidence sets the scope and anything beyond it becomes an optional, plainly declinable line that does not change what the recommendation solves

conflict_axes.name: whole_house_versus_point_of_use_scope
conflict_axes.description: Point-of-entry treatment protects the plumbing and every outlet, point-of-use treatment answers the drinking-water question cheaply, and each is regularly sold where the other was correct.
poles: treat at the main for whole-house benefit
treat at the tap for the drinking-water concern
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: assign each confirmed problem to the location its mechanism and its damage pattern require, allow both where both are confirmed, and state the stage relationship

conflict_axes.name: territory_prior_versus_this_tap_evidence
conflict_axes.description: Territory knowledge makes a technician fast and confident, and confidence about a district is precisely what produces a claim about a house nobody tested.
poles: lead with what the district's water is known to do
assert nothing about this address without a dated sample from it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: use the profile to prepare, stock and hypothesise, and never as the evidence line in a claim, a quote or a demonstration

conflict_axes.name: diagnostic_depth_versus_visit_economics
conflict_axes.description: A thorough survey, screening panel and explanation costs a long unpaid appointment, while a shallow visit produces exactly the mis-specification that generates callbacks.
poles: run the full survey, panel and explanation every time
keep visits short and escalate depth only when the first signals justify it
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: fix a mandatory floor of survey and panel items that always run and let the rest be triggered by problem class, with the trigger written down rather than left to the technician's mood

conflict_axes.name: ion_exchange_softening_versus_salt_free_conditioning
conflict_axes.description: Ion exchange delivers the softened-water experience customers describe wanting and produces a brine discharge governed by local rules, while scale conditioning avoids the discharge and never delivers that experience.
poles: sell true softening for the full hardness experience
sell scale conditioning to avoid brine discharge and salt handling
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: verify the local sewer or septic discharge requirement class first, then match the class to the customer's actual priority and state in writing that conditioning leaves hardness in the water

conflict_axes.name: certification_rigour_versus_price_competitiveness
conflict_axes.description: Insisting on a per-model, per-claim listing removes cheap products from the catalogue and hands price-led customers to competitors who simply print the claim.
poles: quote only listed claims on listed models
quote what the market expects at the price it expects
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hold the listing requirement and compete by making the comparison legible, showing what is listed against what is merely printed and what happens when the cheaper system fails

conflict_axes.name: conveying_real_urgency_versus_never_fear_selling
conflict_axes.description: Some findings genuinely warrant prompt action, such as a coliform-positive well, and the discipline that forbids fear-selling must not flatten a real finding into a shrug.
poles: convey urgency so the household acts
avoid any language that could frighten a household into buying
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: deliver the finding in the words the laboratory and the public-health authority use, name the interim step the authority recommends, refer health questions to that authority, and let the household decide about equipment without a deadline attached

edge_cases.description: A homeowner opens the visit with a viral video claiming the municipal supply is poisoned and wants agreement before anything else happens
edge_cases.trigger: a regional or national water news cycle reaches the household before the appointment
edge_cases.mitigation: acknowledge the concern, show what the utility's report does and does not cover, and offer the specific accredited test for that parameter at this address rather than agreeing or arguing

edge_cases.description: A field nitrate strip reads near the health-based limit in a well household where an infant lives
edge_cases.trigger: a screening reading on a health-based parameter in a sensitive household
edge_cases.mitigation: stop selling immediately, take an accredited-laboratory sample the same day by the laboratory's protocol, give the household the public-health authority's contact for any health question, and quote nothing against the parameter until the report returns

edge_cases.description: A bacteriological result returns positive days after the visit, when the customer is no longer in front of anyone
edge_cases.trigger: an accredited laboratory reports coliform or E. coli on a private well
edge_cases.mitigation: deliver the report with the laboratory's and the health authority's own recommended interim steps, recommend well inspection and disinfection with a confirmatory retest before any equipment is proposed, and refer health questions to the authority

edge_cases.description: The household already owns a competitor's softener and wants it assessed rather than replaced
edge_cases.trigger: existing treatment equipment is present and possibly still under warranty
edge_cases.mitigation: diagnose the existing unit honestly on bypass position, salt bridging, resin age and valve function, quote service where service is the answer, and evidence any replacement recommendation with the test that shows the unit is no longer performing

edge_cases.description: A homeowner association or condominium rule bars the drain connection or outdoor equipment the recommendation assumed
edge_cases.trigger: a governing-document or landlord restriction surfaces during scoping
edge_cases.mitigation: record the restriction as a constraint in the dossier, rescope to what is permissible such as a point-of-use system, and route the drain and placement question to the installation knowledge base before any date is offered

edge_cases.description: An elderly homeowner living alone wants to sign that evening while an adult child who normally advises them is unreachable
edge_cases.trigger: a vulnerability signal coincides with pressure the customer is applying to themselves
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the quoted price open, leave the packet and cancellation notice, offer to return when the relative can attend, and record the customer's own explain-back before any signature is accepted

edge_cases.description: Every test comes back unremarkable and nothing actionable is found
edge_cases.trigger: screening and laboratory results show no exceedance and no aesthetic problem the household is troubled by
edge_cases.mitigation: make the no-system outcome an approved and rewarded result, hand over the full results, explain what would change the answer later, and ask for the referral rather than manufacturing a problem

edge_cases.description: The serving utility switches disinfectant mid-season and recently installed carbon systems begin drawing taste complaints
edge_cases.trigger: a district changes from free chlorine to chloramine or blends a new source
edge_cases.mitigation: re-profile the district from the new notice, revise the standard carbon specification for that area, and contact recent customers with a factual explanation and a service option before they complain

edge_cases.description: The local sewer or septic authority restricts brine discharge from ion-exchange regeneration in the area being quoted
edge_cases.trigger: a discharge, septic or water-conservation requirement class applies to the proposed softening system
edge_cases.mitigation: verify the current requirement with the authority before proposing ion exchange, present scale conditioning or an alternative arrangement with its difference from softening stated in writing, and record the verification in the dossier

edge_cases.description: The accredited laboratory result contradicts the field screening the recommendation was drafted from
edge_cases.trigger: laboratory and screening disagree on a parameter such as iron, manganese or hardness
edge_cases.mitigation: treat the laboratory report as controlling, rebuild the mapping and the quote on it, disclose the change to the customer in writing, and review the screening method or reagent that produced the disagreement

edge_cases.description: During the visit the homeowner asks directly whether the water is causing a family member's illness
edge_cases.trigger: a health question is put to the representative in the home
edge_cases.mitigation: state plainly that the company does not answer health questions, refer the household to their physician and the public-health authority, continue only with chemistry compared to standard classes, and record that the referral was made

workflow.action: Profile the territory by water supply
workflow.description: Resolve each serviced neighbourhood to a named community water system or to private-well status and record source, disinfectant, reported hardness and regional signature with the dated document behind each
workflow.gate: every serviced neighbourhood resolves to a named system or well status with a dated published source, and disinfectant type is recorded per district

workflow.action: Write and train the claim perimeter
workflow.description: Publish the permitted mechanism-claim form, the banned-claim list including all health framing, and the requirement that each claim carry a listing or a dated result, then train and audit the field against it
workflow.gate: the banned-claim list and per-claim evidence requirement exist in the sales kit, in advertising copy review, and in a ride-along scorecard

workflow.description: Capture supply type, symptoms and their history, ownership and authority, prior testing, existing equipment, attendees and site constraints, and refer or decline where treatment is not the answer
workflow.gate: supply type, authority to authorise work, symptom history, existing equipment and attendees are recorded, or a documented referral was made

workflow.action: Pull the published evidence for the address
workflow.description: For municipal addresses retrieve the current annual water-quality report and extract source, disinfectant, hardness, detected parameters and notices; for wells run the well-history questionnaire instead
workflow.gate: a current report with its reporting period is attached for municipal addresses, or a completed well-history record exists for well addresses, and the coverage limits are written in customer language

workflow.description: Record plumbing material and era, heater age, static pressure, staining and scale, shut-off location and any existing treatment equipment, with dated photographs
workflow.gate: plumbing material and era, heater age, shut-off location, existing equipment and the sampling point's position relative to that equipment are documented

workflow.action: Run the screening panel and explain it
workflow.description: Run the standard instruments at recorded sample points, log flush state, temperature and method, and explain each reading as a screening indication in the customer's presence
workflow.gate: every reading records sample point, flush state, temperature, method and date and is labelled screening, and the dissolved-solids reading was explained as mineral content

workflow.action: Escalate to the accredited laboratory where required
workflow.description: Take laboratory samples for every health-based or microbiological parameter in play using the laboratory's bottles and protocol, honour chain of custody, and state turnaround and who pays
workflow.gate: no health-based or microbiological parameter proceeds toward a recommendation on screening alone, and the customer is to receive the report regardless of purchase

workflow.description: Compare each parameter to its applicable health-based or aesthetic standard class with the source cited, state reporting limits honestly, and stop at chemistry and treatment class
workflow.gate: each parameter carries its standard class and cited source, non-detects state the reporting limit, and no health-effect statement appears

workflow.action: Map confirmed problems to treatment classes
workflow.description: Select mechanism classes for confirmed parameters only, check the anti-pattern list, state preconditions, and register every complaint no proposed stage addresses
workflow.gate: every stage names its parameter, dated evidence and precondition, the anti-pattern check is recorded, and unaddressed complaints are listed

workflow.action: Scope treatment location and capture constraints
workflow.description: Assign each confirmed problem to point-of-entry or point-of-use with a stated reason, define stage order where both apply, and record household and property constraints for the installation team
workflow.gate: every confirmed problem has a treatment location with a reason, and each discovered constraint is written into the file

workflow.action: Build the priced tiers and the written packet
workflow.description: Compose coherent tiers from the scoped stages using only listed claims, build each price from the documented cost stack, and assemble the packet with evidence, itemisation, the will-not-do section and the required disclosures
workflow.gate: the packet carries dated evidence, per-component parameter and certification references, itemised pricing, the will-not-do section, warranty terms and the applicable cancellation-rights notice, and contains no health claim

workflow.action: Complete the dossier and hold the gate
workflow.description: Package chemistry, accepted and ruled-out classes, chosen classes with listings, premise facts, constraints, signed disclosures, implied consumables and open questions with owners, then release to installation and service
workflow.gate: no installation date is promised and no service plan is enrolled until the dossier is complete and every claimed problem has its evidence attached

priority_rationale: The territory profile, the claim perimeter and the intake come first because they decide which households are visited, what may be said to them and what is known before arrival; the diagnostic layer (utility report, well path, premise survey, screening panel, honest demonstration, laboratory escalation and standard-class interpretation) precedes every offer node because nothing may be recommended or priced ahead of its evidence; the offer layer (mechanism reference, certification vetting, problem-to-class mapping, treatment-location scoping, tier architecture and cost build-up) converts confirmed findings into comparable, certified, honestly priced options; and the closing and handoff layer (visit protocol, quote and disclosure packet, misinformation handling and diagnostic dossier) exists last because it packages an evidence-led recommendation into something a household, an installer and a service scheduler can all act on without rediscovery.

dominance_rules.rule: Dated evidence from this address dominates enthusiasm, symptom language and territory knowledge
dominance_rules.rationale: every retraction, refund and complaint in this trade begins with a claim that outran its evidence
dominance_rules.trigger: a recommendation, claim or price is about to be presented for a problem with no dated result from this address
dominance_rules.action: gather the evidence first, or record the finding as unconfirmed and present nothing priced against it

dominance_rules.rule: The prohibition on health and medical claims dominates every sales objective
dominance_rules.rationale: a health claim is both outside the company's competence and the fastest route to regulatory and reputational harm
dominance_rules.trigger: any question, objection or opportunity that invites a health answer about the water
dominance_rules.action: restate the finding as chemistry against a standard class, refer health questions to a physician or the public-health authority, and proceed or end the visit without the claim

dominance_rules.rule: The accredited laboratory report dominates any field screening reading that disagrees with it
dominance_rules.rationale: the laboratory has known methods, reporting limits and accreditation while a field reading has none of these
dominance_rules.trigger: a laboratory result contradicts a strip, titration or meter reading the recommendation was built on
dominance_rules.action: rebuild the mapping and the quote on the laboratory result and disclose the change to the customer in writing

dominance_rules.rule: A dated sample from this tap dominates the utility report and the territory profile
dominance_rules.rationale: published figures describe a system over a period, not a house on a day, and premise plumbing sits between them
dominance_rules.trigger: published or territory-level figures disagree with the sample taken at the address
dominance_rules.action: use the sample as the evidence for any recommendation and keep the published figures as context only

dominance_rules.rationale: a sale that a household or its family would not endorse a week later is worth less than no sale
dominance_rules.trigger: any vulnerability signal appears during the appointment
dominance_rules.action: hold the price, involve a trusted second person, defer the decision without penalty and hand over the cancellation-rights notice

dominance_rules.rule: Minimal sufficient treatment dominates job margin
dominance_rules.rationale: scope justified by evidence is the company's whole differentiation, and one unjustified stage discredits the rest
dominance_rules.trigger: an additional or larger stage would improve margin without a dated result behind it
dominance_rules.action: remove the stage from the recommendation or present it as a clearly optional line that changes nothing about what is solved

dominance_rules.rule: The certification listing dominates manufacturer marketing literature
dominance_rules.rationale: the listing is the enforceable statement of what the model was tested to do, and the brochure is not
dominance_rules.trigger: marketing copy claims a reduction the model's current listing does not carry
dominance_rules.action: strike the claim from the quote and from the conversation and quote only listed claims

dominance_rules.rule: A local regulatory requirement class dominates the preferred technical design
dominance_rules.rationale: discharge, permitting and licensing rules decide what may lawfully be installed regardless of what the water chemistry favours
dominance_rules.trigger: brine or reject discharge rules, permit requirements or licensing limits may apply to the proposed class
dominance_rules.action: verify the current requirement with the authority having jurisdiction before proposing, and present the compliant alternative with its real differences stated in writing

dominance_rules.rule: Referral dominates the sale when the defect is not treatable water
dominance_rules.rationale: equipment sold on top of a failing well, heater or plumbing defect fails visibly and takes the referral base with it
dominance_rules.trigger: the evidence points at a well, pump, heater or plumbing failure rather than at water chemistry
dominance_rules.action: refer to the appropriate licensed contractor, record the referral in the dossier, and accept the lost sale

dominance_rules.rule: The demonstration ban dominates competitive pressure
dominance_rules.rationale: a demonstration that survives only while the customer misunderstands it is a liability the company cannot insure
dominance_rules.trigger: a competitor's theatrical demonstration is beating the company's honest one in the same neighbourhood
dominance_rules.action: explain the mechanism of the rival demonstration, offer the accredited test that settles the question, and never match the theatre

anti_rework_rules.rule: Establish supply type and ownership authority on the first call, before a test visit is booked
anti_rework_rules.prevents: wasted trips to tenants without authority and visits arriving with the wrong panel for a well or a municipal address

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the district's report and confirm the disinfectant before selecting reagents and carbon specification
anti_rework_rules.prevents: specifying plain carbon into a chloraminated district and refitting it after taste complaints

anti_rework_rules.rule: Survey plumbing material, era and existing equipment before taking samples
anti_rework_rules.prevents: sampling downstream of an existing softener or flushing away a lead first-draw, then paying for the laboratory run twice

anti_rework_rules.rule: Escalate every health-based parameter to the accredited laboratory before any recommendation that touches it is written
anti_rework_rules.prevents: issuing a quote and a claim that must later be retracted when the report contradicts the screening

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify the certification listing for the exact model and claim before it appears in a quote
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a retraction, refund or advertising complaint over a claim the listing never covered

anti_rework_rules.rule: Verify local discharge, permit and licensing requirement classes for the proposed treatment class before presenting it
anti_rework_rules.prevents: selling a system that cannot lawfully be installed as proposed and re-quoting the job from scratch

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm that every decision-maker will attend before scheduling the presentation visit
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a second presentation visit and the discount spiral that usually accompanies it

anti_rework_rules.rule: Record the consumables each chosen class implies at quote time

iteration_protocol.trigger: an accredited laboratory result contradicts the screening the recommendation was drafted from
iteration_protocol.action: rebuild the mapping on the laboratory report, reissue the quote and dossier, disclose the change in writing and review the screening method that disagreed

iteration_protocol.trigger: a complaint, chargeback or cancellation alleges pressure, surprise or a health claim made in the home
iteration_protocol.action: audit the visit record and leave-behind, retrain the representative against the claim perimeter and vulnerability safeguards, and revise whichever script line permitted it

iteration_protocol.trigger: a manufacturer revises a model, narrows a claim or loses a certification listing
iteration_protocol.action: re-vet the listing, pull the affected claims from every quote template and brochure, and notify any open quotes that relied on them

iteration_protocol.trigger: a utility changes source or disinfectant, or a local water event occurs
iteration_protocol.action: re-profile the district from the new notice, revise the affected specifications, and prepare a factual message for recent customers before complaints arrive

iteration_protocol.trigger: the service team reports post-install dissatisfaction of the form that a complaint was never resolved
iteration_protocol.action: trace the complaint back to the mapping and the will-not-do section, correct the unaddressed-complaint discipline, and feed the pattern back into problem-class segmentation

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new contaminant or water story enters public attention in the territory
iteration_protocol.action: prepare the mechanism explanation, confirm which treatment classes and models are actually listed for that contaminant, arrange the laboratory panel that answers it, and brief the field

iteration_protocol.trigger: measured job margin drifts from the build-up, or a tier is chronically unsold or always discounted
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the cost stack from current distributor quotes, timesheets and permit receipts, and reconsider the tier structure without adding unevidenced stages

iteration_protocol.trigger: laboratory pricing changes or a subsidised public testing programme appears or disappears
iteration_protocol.action: revisit the written who-pays policy for escalated testing and the intake language that sets expectations about it
